title: Qualify admitted scientific families and owner-gated reuse request
commitMessage: docs: qualify M6 scientific family pins and Decision reuse assessment

contribution.summary: Qualify C05-T1 as a documentary scientific adoption gate: list seven independently admitted families with oracle, bounded contract, source/evidence SHA pin and historical provider version. Preserve the RS102 preview.14 seven-client NuGet receipt without rerunning product science. Publish one owner-gated Decision bounded-root reuse assessment, not confirmed duplication or cutover. Close C05-T1 Q/O/D and T1 only; leave C05-T2, C05, M6-W02 and M6 open.
contribution.value: Record source/evidence pins and exact local package receipt from durable RS102, distinguishing historical preview admission from cumulative package requalification. The Decision request identifies only bounded scalar bracketed-bisection as a possible shared primitive with explicit oracles, typed no-partial refusal, owner triage, semver/notices review and no sibling mutation.
debtChanges: Distinguish seven historical family admission pins from the cumulative RS102 preview.14 local NuGet receipt; never rewrite old provenance as fresh execution.
Require one independent oracle, finite domain limits, stable source/evidence SHA-256 and historical provider version for every admitted scientific family.
Preserve exact RS102 37,270-byte SHA and seven eight-probe isolated source-free consumer receipts as historical evidence, not tests newly run.
Publish a bounded scalar bracketed-bisection Decision deduplication assessment with explicit future oracles and deterministic refusal rules.
Do not assert an existing duplicate in Decision or perform a sibling repository write, package cutover, public NuGet release or dw.discovery activation.
Complete the document-only Question/Observation/Decision native lifecycle and planning parity; leave the optional C05-T2 owner/semver gate open.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS103 success, prepare RS104 on C05-T2: disposition of optional adoption, owner-gated semver/notices, immutable provider pins and explicit no-cutover rules; consider C05/M6-W02/M6 closure only after its independent documentary evidence. Do not invent Decision approval or publish NuGet. RS103 incurred a pre-attempt authoring refusal; do not claim first-pass.

achievements.achievement: Identify seven previously admitted BCL-only scientific families and bound documentary scope without new product claims.
Verify seven durable source/provenance/version pins, independent oracles and seven retained RS102 local package consumer receipts.
Publish an owner-gated bounded-root Decision assessment and decide no external cutover, with explicit limits and semver/notices gate.
Qualify C05-T1 scientific adoption matrix and targeted reuse proposal; retain T2, C05, M6-W02 and M6 open.
